name: Bluetooth & BLE Protocol Analysis
description: Ability to analyze the security of Bluetooth Classic and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) protocols. Covers BLE GATT/ATT service enumeration, pairing mechanism analysis (Just Works, Passkey, OOB, Numeric Comparison), sniffing of BLE advertisement and connection traffic, Bluetooth Classic L2CAP and SDP analysis, and assessment of device authentication and encryption implementations.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Bluetooth or BLE security analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Bluetooth/BLE protocol architecture and known security concerns
evidence: Can describe the Bluetooth protocol stack (HCI, L2CAP, SDP, RFCOMM) and BLE (GATT, ATT, GAP)
Understands LE Legacy Pairing vs LE Secure Connections, the pairing association models, and their relative security properties
Completed training on Bluetooth/BLE security assessment methodology

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs BLE scanning, enumeration, and traffic capture under supervision
evidence: Scanned and enumerated BLE devices and GATT services using gatttool or equivalent under guidance
Captured BLE advertisement and connection traffic using Ubertooth or nRF Sniffer under supervision
Identified pairing mode and encryption configuration of BLE devices with assistance

3.label: Independent Practice
evidence: Independently assessed Bluetooth/BLE security for 3+ different device types
Captured and decoded pairing exchanges to evaluate authentication strength
Identified unprotected GATT characteristics exposing sensitive data or control functions
Produced reports documenting BLE security findings with protocol traces and remediation guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced Bluetooth attacks; analyzes custom BLE profiles; develops assessment tools
evidence: Exploited Bluetooth pairing, authentication, and reconnection weaknesses (e.g., KNOB key-size negotiation, BIAS impersonation, BLURtooth cross-transport key overwrite, BLESA reconnection spoofing) in device assessments
Reverse-engineered proprietary BLE profiles and custom GATT services
Developed BLE fuzzing or automated assessment tools for the lab
Mentors junior analysts on Bluetooth/BLE assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on Bluetooth/BLE security; discovers implementation vulnerabilities
evidence: Published research on Bluetooth or BLE security vulnerabilities
Discovered novel Bluetooth/BLE implementation vulnerabilities in commercial devices
Authored the lab's Bluetooth/BLE security assessment methodology
Trains teams on Bluetooth/BLE protocol security and develops custom analysis tools

assessment_methods.description: Assess the BLE security of a target IoT device: enumerate services, capture pairing traffic, evaluate encryption, and document exploitable weaknesses
Review Bluetooth/BLE security assessment reports for protocol analysis depth and finding accuracy

equipment: nRF52-based BLE 5 sniffer (e.g. Sniffle); Ubertooth One for BLE 4.x
Sena UD100 or equivalent Bluetooth Classic adapter
